hooks.logic:
Let v5 be this state.
Let currentDyingChildren be the register's 'currentDyingChildren'.
Let v6 be each x in currentDyingChildren mapped to the value "no" of x.
Call game:ai.StateSnippet.CustomInterruptMultipleAbility.addDeformMulti with (v5, [[{builtin: "UNSET_ALL_SA", saChildNos: v6}], [{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: the INVISIBLE status, saChildNos: v6}], [{builtin: "CANCEL_INTERRUPT_ABILITY", cancelIAChildNos: v6}], [{builtin: "WAIT", waitMsec: 1}]]).
Let v7 be call helper with (v5).
For each x in v6
  If v7 is not empty, then call game:ai.StateSnippet.CustomInterruptMultipleAbility.addAbility with (v5, {abilityTag: "mystery_waltz", abilityOptions: {id: x}}).
  Call game:ai.StateSnippet.CustomInterruptMultipleAbility.addDeformMulti with (v5, call game:ai.AiUtil.makeSequenceForInvisibleDead with ({nos: [x], deformTag: data at x, shouldDeath: false})).
If v7 is not empty, then
  Let v8 be data2 at (the length of v7).
  Let data3 be {statusAilmentsOptions: {boost: {rate: the numeric entry v8 in the battle settings of the enemy}}}.
  Call game:ai.StateSnippet.CustomInterruptMultipleAbility.addDeformMulti with (v5, [[{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: [the HASTE status, the PROTECT status, the SHELL status], saChildNos: v7}], [{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: [the CUSTOM_ATK_FOR_AI status, the CUSTOM_DEF_FOR_AI status, the CUSTOM_MDEF_FOR_AI status], saChildNos: v7, saOptions: data3}]]).
Call game:ai.StateSnippet.CustomInterruptMultipleAbility.setInterruptBeforeCounter with (v5).
